page_title: NOT 2-0 AST | Nottingham Forest v Aston Villa 05/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
90+5' Aston Villa try to speed play up by taking a quick free kick.
90+4' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Jarred Gillett blows his whistle for a foul. Aston Villa are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
90+2' The attendance for today's match is 29313.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
88' Booking. Danilo (Nottingham) receives a caution from the referee.
87' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Nicolas Dominguez.
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ola Aina trots off the pitch and is replaced by Neco Williams (Nottingham).
86' Unai Emery prepares a substitution. Douglas Luiz is replaced by Leander Dendoncker (Aston Villa).
85' Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
84' The linesman raises his flag. Danilo (Nottingham) is adjudged offside.
82' Taiwo Awoniyi comes off the pitch to be replaced by Danilo (Nottingham).
81' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
80' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

80' John McGinn (Aston Villa) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear. Aston Villa force a corner. They send men into the box.
79' A lofted cross from Diego Carlos (Aston Villa) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The referee signals a corner kick to Aston Villa.
78' The manager makes a subsitution with Diego Carlos (Aston Villa) coming on for Boubacar Kamara.
78' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies just over the crossbar.
77' Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) challenges for the lofted pass into the centre of the box, but has to stretch too much and sends his header narrowly wide of the left post.
77' Odysseas Vlachodimos (Nottingham) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
75' Odysseas Vlachodimos (Nottingham) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
73' John McGinn (Aston Villa) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

73' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Leon Bailey (Aston Villa). The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Aston Villa will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
73' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
71' A substitution has been made. Harry Toffolo is replaced by Serge Aurier (Nottingham).
70' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
69' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) gets on the end of a lofted pass near the penalty spot, but it's a poor header and drifts high over the bar.
68' Excellent touch by Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa)! He latches on to a precise pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a terrific save.
67' A clumsy foul by Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) and Jarred Gillett blows his whistle.
67' John McGinn (Aston Villa) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
66' A player from Nottingham commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
64' Boubacar Kamara (Aston Villa) gets booked for the first time in this match.
63' A cross into the box from Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) is cleared.
61' Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Jarred Gillett stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
59' It's time for a substitution. Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) comes on in place of Matty Cash.
59' A clever short pass gives Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball high over the bar.
57' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) is adjudged offside.
56' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) is flagged for offside.
55' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
54' The corner from Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) is cleared away by the defence.
54' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. The referee blows his whistle, Aston Villa are awarded a corner kick.
52' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
50' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Emiliano Martinez pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
49' Jarred Gillett sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
48' The Nottingham players halt their celebrations as referee Jarred Gillett makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
47' 2 - 0 Orel Mangala (Nottingham) latches on to a brilliant pass and hits a poor shot towards the middle of the goal, but the ball goes into the back of the net after the goalkeeper makes a howler!
46' Unai Emery makes a half-time substitution. Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) comes on in place of Nicolo Zaniolo.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty as the referee indicates there was no infringement.

45+2' Play continues despite the shouts by some Nottingham players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Jarred Gillett interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
45+1' Flag goes up against Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
44' The game is interrupted as Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) is flagged offside.
42' A dangerous looking corner kick from Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) is cleared to safety by the defence.

42' Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a clever chip pass, but one of the defending players comes up with a timely interception. The ball is out of play. Aston Villa will have a chance to score from a corner.
41' One of the players from Nottingham times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.

39' Ambitious effort from Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
38' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) whips in a cross from the corner, but Odysseas Vlachodimos is well positioned and punches the ball away.
37' Pau Torres (Aston Villa) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. Aston Villa force their opponents to concede a corner.
37' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.

36' Great save! Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom left corner was brilliantly saved by Odysseas Vlachodimos. The ball goes behind for a corner. Aston Villa will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
36' Harry Toffolo (Nottingham) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
34' John McGinn (Aston Villa) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
31' Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) sprints into the box to get on the end of a cross and directs a shot goalwards that flies just over the bar. Unlucky!
30' Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) gets a shot from inside the penalty area and it flies just wide of the left post.
28' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
27' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
27' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) announces himself with a close-range shot after a cross, but one of the defenders gets in the way of the ball to thwart him. Aston Villa earn a corner.
26' John McGinn (Aston Villa) takes a short corner kick.
26' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Aston Villa.
25' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
25' Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
22' Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards the top of the net, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Odysseas Vlachodimos.
21' Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) is caught offside!
19' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
17' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
15' Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) pounces on the cross into the centre of the box, but hangs his head in shame after sending his header well wide of the left post when the keeper was on his backside.
15' Jarred Gillett blows his whistle and it's Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
14' The free kick is taken by Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham), but ball is cleared.
13' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) tackles a bit over-zealously and Jarred Gillett blows for a foul.
13' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
13' John McGinn (Aston Villa) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

12' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant long-range cross, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Aston Villa.
9' Boubacar Kamara (Aston Villa) sprays a pass out to Moussa Diaby, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball.
5' 1 - 0 Goal! Ola Aina (Nottingham) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the bottom left corner.
4' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) receives a pass and unleashes a shot which goes well wide of the right post.
3' Ezri Konsa (Aston Villa) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
